semantic_fragments.content: Single Fault Condition test 13.2.8: When the pump or valve part is stuck (locking of moving parts), the equipment stops working. This condition does not result in a HAZARDOUS SITUATION (No).

Per clause 13.1.2, SINGLE FAULT CONDITIONS related to emission of flames, molten metal, or ignitable substances may be waived if power dissipated is less than 15 W and energy dissipated is less than 900 J.

Per clause 13.2.10, for every test in SINGLE FAULT CONDITION of 13.2.8 and 13.2.9, motor-operated EQUIPMENT is started from COLD CONDITION at RATED voltage or upper limit of RATED voltage range for specified time. Temperatures of windings are determined at end of specified test periods or at the instant of operation of fuses, THERMAL CUT-OUTS, or motor protective devices. Temperatures measured as specified in 11.1.3 d) and must not exceed limits of Table 26. All results: N/A.
